verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents creating and e-filing unlimited 1099-MISC/1099-NEC forms with the IRS and automatically sending copies to contractors. Employees can access their W-2s online or in the app, which implies W-2s are generated and distributed through a self-service portal, and the service also handles federal and state payroll tax filing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that W-2s are automatically generated and filed at year-end, detail on W-2 distribution beyond portal access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
